# pagerly_team (Data Source)

Look up a team by name or id.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "pagerly_team" "payments" {
  name = "Payments"   # or id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Team id. One of `id` or `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Team name, case-insensitive.

### Read-Only

- `current_oncall` (String) Email of whoever is on call now.
- `slack_channel` (String)
- `timezone` (String)
